name: Tap Card
summary: Gibraltar-licensed crypto card with up to 8% cashback via XTP token. No monthly or issuance fees. Free loading, 1.5% FX for non-card currency transactions.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

faq.question: Does the Tap Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is free.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the Tap Card?
faq.answer: It charges about 1.5% on non-base-currency spending.
